title: Appel and Haken: every planar map is four colorable (Illinois Journal of Mathematics, 1977)
summary: Kenneth Appel and Wolfgang Haken published a two-part paper in the Illinois Journal of Mathematics in September 1977 titled 'Every planar map is four colorable', with John Koch a co-author of Part II.
body: The claim is stated in the title of the paper itself: every planar map is four colorable. The DOI registry (Crossref) records 'Every planar map is four colorable. Part I: Discharging' by K. Appel and W. Haken in the Illinois Journal of Mathematics, volume 21, issue 3, pages 429–490, dated 1 September 1977, with publisher Duke University Press. It records 'Every planar map is four colorable. Part II: Reducibility' by K. Appel, W. Haken and J. Koch in the same journal, volume and issue, pages 491–567, dated 1 September 1977. The registry also records a 'Microfiche supplement to "Every planar map is four colorable"' by K. Appel and W. Haken in the same volume and issue.
